shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && git show --stat HEAD | head -50
cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts src/*.tsx index.html .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md
rg -n -i -C 6 'chartkit|yagr|@gravity-ui/charts' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n '1,200p'; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -250; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60
npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit versions --json | tail -25; for v in 7 8; do echo "== $v"; npm view "@gravity-ui/chartkit@^$v" version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -12; done

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 2>&1 | tail -15; grep -A8 '"dependencies"' package.json; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh chartkit ChartKit settings ChartKitRef YagrPlugin GravityChartsPlugin ChartKitWidgetData ChartKitWidget

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh chartkit ChartKit settings ChartKitRef YagrPlugin GravityChartsPlugin; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; for p in charts yagr; do node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json').version"; done

which rg; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs -R | head -40; find node_modules -path '*@gravity-ui/charts/package.json' -maxdepth 6; grep -E '"(dependencies|peerDependencies)"' -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify(require("./package.json").exports,null,1))' | head -40; cat build/index.d.ts; ls build/types build/plugins build/plugins/yagr build/plugins/gravity-charts 2>&1; cat build/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && cat types/widget.d.ts plugins/yagr/index.d.ts plugins/yagr/types.d.ts plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts; cat components/ChartKit.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls components

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/index.js chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.js; Y=$(find chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr yagr -maxdepth 0 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "yagr at $Y"; node -p "require('./$Y/package.json').version"; ls $Y/dist; grep -n -E 'interface (RawSerieData|YagrConfig|YagrChartOptions|ProcessingSettings|LegendOptions|AxisOptions)\b' -r $Y/dist/types | head

grep -n '"sideEffects"' -A4 chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json chartkit/package.json; node -p "require('./chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json').version"; ls yagr/dist/YagrCore; grep -rn -E '^(export )?(interface|type) (RawSerieData|YagrConfig|SeriesOptions|ProcessingSettings|LegendOptions|AxisOptions|YagrChartOptions|TooltipOptions)\b' yagr/dist --include=*.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore && sed -n 43,120p types.d.ts; sed -n 166,215p types.d.ts; sed -n 230,310p types.d.ts; sed -n 1,20p plugins/legend/legend.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit && grep -rn -i 'theme\|timeMultiplier' build/plugins/yagr/renderer/*.js | head -15; cat build/components/ChartKit.js | head -80; C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; ls $C/types 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n -E '^export (interface|type) ChartData\b' -A30 -r $C/types --include=*.d.ts | head -45
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist && ls; grep -rln 'interface ChartData\b\|type ChartData\b' --include=*.d.ts . | head
grep -n 'ChartData' -A28 esm/core/types/index.d.ts | head -40; ls docs docs/* | head -30

ls docs/guides/axes docs/guides/series-types; grep -n -i 'datetime\|dateTimeLabelFormat' -C3 docs/guides/axes/*.md | head -50; grep -n -E "^\s+(title|xAxis|yAxis|series|tooltip|split)\??:" esm/core/types/index.d.ts | head; grep -n -A12 'export interface LineSeries ' esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30
sed -n 1,60p docs/guides/series-types/line.md; grep -n -E 'title\?|enabled\?' esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts esm/core/types/chart/legend.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; grep -n -E 'view\?|theme\?|title\?|message\?|layout\?' Alert/types.d.ts | head; grep -n -E 'size\?' Loader/Loader.d.ts; grep -n -E 'view\?|type\?|theme\?|size\?' Card/Card.d.ts
grep -n -A14 'interface ControlGroupProps' types.d.ts; sed -n 1,30p Card/Card.d.ts | grep -n -E 'type Card(View|Type)|SelectionCardView|ContainerCardView' ; grep -n 'AlertTheme =' Alert/types.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/libs && ls; cat settings/settings.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n -E 'actions\?|onClose\?|layout\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/types.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30
npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/dist/assets && M=$(ls index-*.js); echo "main=$M"; echo "-- static imports in main:"; grep -o 'from"\./[^"]*"' $M | sort -u; echo "-- dynamic imports in main:"; grep -o 'import("\./[^"]*")' $M | sort -u; echo "-- engine markers (count) main / yagr / charts:"; for pat in 'u-over' 'uplot' 'gcharts' 'd3-'; do printf '%-8s %s / %s / %s\n' "$pat" "$(grep -c -- "$pat" $M)" "$(grep -c -- "$pat" YagrWidget-*.js)" "$(grep -c -- "$pat" GravityChartsWidget-*.js)"; done; echo "-- who imports isEmpty chunk:"; grep -l 'isEmpty-' *.js; grep -o '"[^"]*\.css"' ../index.html; ls *.css
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat dist/index.html; grep -o '.\{80\}isEmpty-[^"]*\.js.\{120\}' dist/assets/index-*.js | head -3
npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -12 && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|✓ built|Widget-'
rm -rf dist && git status --short
